items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: playing under Harry Lantz in that youth orchestra

ctx.x: No. Not really. I led a double life. I went to a very good parochial high school, St. Thomas High School. And my father sent me there because he had gone to a parochial high school in Tulsa when he was a kid. He said later with the public schools if you go to St. Thomas you’re really going to get an education, and I did. It was harder than university in some ways. So they had no music program really. They did but it was in its early stages and it really wasn’t happening. So what I was mainly involved in were my…

Right. You had said that you learned to play with bass players on that gig, also with records. Can you put into words what that means? Because I was a little surprised along the way here talking to some bass players and drummers that there are times when people are mismatched, that they don’t feel time in the same way. Has that been your experience?
